stem.text: A string is fixed between point P and an oscillator M. Another string is fixed between M and point Q. M is midway between P and Q.

stem.alt: Two strings fixed at walls labelled P and Q, with an oscillator labelled M between them, drawn in a straight line.

stem.text: The frequency of the oscillator is adjusted until a stationary wave is formed on both strings. The speed of the wave between P and M is twice the speed of the wave between M and Q.
Which diagram could represent the stationary wave pattern?

A.alt: Diagram of a stationary wave pattern from P to Q, with point M labelled.
